entries.expected_behavior: Mixed-offset failed_at values are compared by instant and the limited retry selects the truly oldest job.
Normal malformed input boundaries share the smallest coherent table-driven public-entrypoint test.
The integer-limit and excessive-depth cases are fixed and verified once without preserving disproportionate permanent cases.
The boolean helper concern is recorded as unreachable through the string-valued CLI and creates no permanent test.
A corrupt throttle value is handled silently and the isolated repair receives a focused table case and targeted rereview.
Codex preflight waits for updater completion; the cross-process operational-boundary repair keeps permanent coverage and a full rereview.
